content: Sparkling water, also known as carbonated water, soda water, seltzer water, or fizzy water, is water into which carbon dioxide gas under pressure has been dissolved, causing effervescent bubbles and a slight popping sensation on the tongue. It can be natural (sourced from a spring or well and naturally carbonated), or it can be created artificially by dissolving carbon dioxide under pressure into the water. Some sparkling waters also have added minerals or salts to enhance their flavor.
